items.description: A print and play escape room. Introducing 'The Secret of Langton Manor': A Free Printable Escape Room Game

items.markdown:
You can download and set up free printable escape rooms and puzzle games from several online resources for home, school, or party use.

### Top Free Printable Escape Room Options

- **Puzzling Pursuits:** Offers [10 Free Printable Escape Room Puzzles](https://puzzlingpursuits.com/blogs/learn/free-printable-escape-room-puzzles) on individual one-page sheets or as a single PDF. They range from introductory to expert levels with star ratings and require no account or email.[[1]](https://puzzlingpursuits.com/blogs/learn/free-printable-escape-room-puzzles)
- **Escape Team:** Provides a [Free Escape Room DIY Kit](https://www.escape-team.com/free-escape-room-diy-kit) featuring a starter kit, customizable puzzles, and a mission editor app to verify solution codes and play audio narration.[[1]](https://www.escape-team.com/free-escape-room-diy-kit)
- **Printable Escapes:** Features a free short-format adventure called [Nordic Necklace](https://www.printableescapes.com/games/freeescapegame.html) that includes story clues, hints, and answers.[[1]](https://www.printableescapes.com/games/freeescapegame.html)
- **Teaching Ideas:** Offers a [Free Printable Escape Room For Kids](https://teachingideas.ca/2022/04/18/free-printable-escape-room/) that uses common household hiding places (like shoes, pillows, and coats) to lead players to a final certificate.[[1]](https://teachingideas.ca/2022/04/18/free-printable-escape-room/)
- **Teachers Pay Teachers:** Features various educator-created options such as the [Team Building Escape Room Game](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/hands-on-activities/escape-rooms/free) designed with a spooky manor theme for children.[[1]](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse/hands-on-activities/escape-rooms/free)

Are you looking for an escape room for **children, teens, or adults** , and do you prefer a **paper-based puzzle sheet** or a **house-wide scavenger hunt style** game?
